package example.bankwealth.v2.domain.invariants

import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.entities.CreditBalanceEntity._
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.invariants.params.CreditBalanceRuleParams._
import example.bankwealth.v2.domain.services.CreditBalanceComputations
import net.imadz.common.CommonTypes.{InvariantRule, iMadzError}

object CreditBalanceRules {
  // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/aggregates/CreditBalance/commands/ReserveFunds
  final class ReserveFundsRule(hosts: CreditBalanceComputations)
      extends InvariantRule[Event, State, ReserveFundsParams] {
    override def apply(state: State, p: ReserveFundsParams): Either[iMadzError, List[Event]] = {
      // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/behaviors/CreditBalance.ReserveFunds/rules/BAL_NON_POSITIVE_AMOUNT
      if ((p.amount <= BigDecimal("0.00"))) Left(iMadzError("BAL_NON_POSITIVE_AMOUNT", "BAL_NON_POSITIVE_AMOUNT"))
      // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/behaviors/CreditBalance.ReserveFunds/rules/BAL_TX_ALREADY_RESERVED
      else if ((state.reservedByTx.contains(p.txId))) Left(iMadzError("BAL_TX_ALREADY_RESERVED", "BAL_TX_ALREADY_RESERVED"))
      // @knowledge source:bank-wealth/bankwealth#/behaviors/CreditBalance.ReserveFunds/rules/BAL_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
      else if ((state.availableAmount < p.amount)) Left(iMadzError("BAL_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS", "BAL_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS"))
      else Right(List(FundsReserved(p.txId, p.amount)))
    }
  }

  def checkEventPostconditions(events: List[Event]): Option[iMadzError] =
    events.iterator.map(checkEventPostcondition).collectFirst { case Some(error) => error }

  private def checkEventPostcondition(event: Event): Option[iMadzError] = event match {
    case e: FundsReserved =>
      if (Option(e.txId).forall(_.trim.isEmpty)) Some(iMadzError("CREDIT_BALANCE_FUNDS_RESERVED_TX_ID_EMPTY", "FundsReserved.txId must not be empty"))
      else None
    case _ => None
  }
}
